script_text: Mercury's opposition to Neptune in your 12th House dissolves your boundaries this week, Pisces, scattering clarity into illusion. Monday through Wednesday brings mental fog as the Moon squares your 6th House, making Monday and Tuesday your weakest days for decision-making, while Thursday's Sun sextile Jupiter in your 9th grants unexpected clarity. Mid-week, Mars trines your 2nd House, igniting financial courage and a surge of confidence in your value. Thursday through Sunday reveals Venus's gentle square to Pluto in your 7th House, stirring intense emotional patterns in relationships—expect one connection to demand authenticity. Wednesday is your power day because Mars activates your career sector directly. Tuesday is your weakest day because Mercury's opposition amplifies confusion. Trust your intuition this week, especially when it speaks through dreams or sudden insights. Follow for daily updates.
